eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Siskiyou, CA; at 5:39 PM on AUG 31, 2025 Effective until 1:39 AM SEP 1, 2025. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The Siskiyou County Sheriffs Office has issued an evacuation order for Zone 1118-B south of Seiad Valley due to the Blue Fire... Anyone in this area is ordered to leave immediately....
